title: The Snow Demon Sky Ape
summary: Xiao Yan trains alone in the mountains of the Inner Academy under Yao Lao. He subdues the wind-lightning strength with the Green Lotus Core Flame and reaches Lightning Flash, the first of the three levels of the Three Thousand Lightning Movement. During training he also stumbles on a new way of moving his Dou Qi in waves, which Yao Lao says could one day become his own method. Nearby, Han Yue, Lin Xiu Ya and Yan Hao attack the Snow Demon Sky Ape to steal the Core Quenching Body Milk it guards. When the ape's violent blood awakens, Xiao Yan saves Han Yue and talks the group into retreating. That night he feeds the Heaven Swallowing Python Amethyst Essence, warns it not to let Medusa devour its soul, and sends it back to fight the ape.
events: Xiao Yan refines the wind-lightning strength from the scroll with the Green Lotus Core Flame.
He finds he can hang in the air without his Purple Cloud Wings; Yao Lao explains it is his soul power gathering wind-lightning at his feet.
He reaches Lightning Flash, the first level of the Three Thousand Lightning Movement.
He grasps a wave-like way of moving Dou Qi.
Han Yue, Lin Xiu Ya and Yan Hao fight the Snow Demon Sky Ape for the Core Quenching Body Milk; Lin Xiu Ya fakes Dou Qi Wings.
The ape's violent blood awakens; Xiao Yan rescues Han Yue and persuades the group to leave.
At night Xiao Yan feeds the Heaven Swallowing Python Amethyst Essence and sends it against the ape.
introduced: Three Thousand Lightning Movement levels: Lightning Flash, Instant Lightning, Three Thousand Lightning
violent blood (of the Snow Demon Sky Ape)
cultivation: Xiao Yan reaches the first level, Lightning Flash, of the Three Thousand Lightning Movement. Lin Xiu Ya is not a Dou Wang; his wings are a technique, not Dou Qi Wings.
